label: Hover
description: Wash of the text colour over a hovered fill.

label: Selected step
description: How far a selected row or tile steps from the surface (OKLab lightness).

label: Selected colour
description: Share of the accent's chroma a selected fill keeps.

label: Applied step
description: Lightness step of the applied (current) marker fill.

label: Applied colour
description: Share of the status hue's chroma the applied marker fill keeps.

label: Disabled text
description: Share of the text colour kept by unavailable content.

label: Disabled fill
description: Share of the text colour in unavailable fills and borders.

label: Hover text tint
description: How far text moves toward the accent on hover.

label: Active text tint
description: How far text moves toward the accent when pressed or selected.

label: Body contrast
description: Target contrast for body text; 4.5 is the floor.

label: Border text mix
description: How much of the text colour the resting border borrows.

label: Focus ring text mix
description: How much of the text colour the focus ring borrows.

label: Hover border accent
description: Accent share of the optional hover border.
